title: 5 Whence the truth and certainty of the goſpel maie appeare.

segments.text: THe truth and certainty of the goſpell, that is, of the promiſe of grace appeareth, 1. By the teſtimony of the holy ghoſt. 2. By the prophecies which haue bin vttered by the Prophets and other holy men. 3. By the fulfilling of thoſe Prophecies, which was accompliſhed in the new Teſtament. 4. By the miracles, whereby the doctrine of the goſpel was confirmed. 5. By the end or property of the doctrine of the goſpel: Becauſe that alone ſheweth the way how to eſcape death and ſinne.
